hypothesis: A planned mixture decomposition with an explicit interaction term will distinguish known composition-only and within-state-only synthetic mean shifts before being used to interpret biological predictions.
rationale: Pseudobulk changes used by de_score, de_direction and severity_slope combine state proportions and conditional means; mmd_u also responds to their distributions. Compare unchanged, composition-only, expression-only and joint predictors with fixed sampling, and report interaction rather than naming all shifts regulation.
